summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Added 16 new pytest cases (test_iteration2.py) for costs, used parts + stock deduction, manual status by mitarbeiter, admin revenue stats, techniker DSGVO — all 16 PASS. Full frontend Playwright covered every new data-testid across MITARBEITER (mohini), TECHNIKER (chris), ADMIN roles: live cost calc, cost save/status badges, used-part add/remove with inventory deduction, manual-status-select, assign-technician, Abholschein modal + print/download-pdf buttons, live camera modal open/close on both create + detail, techniker DSGVO (no PII leak), full status flow ANGENOMMEN → IN_BEARBEITUNG → WARTEN_ERSATZTEIL → resume → FERTIG, and admin metric-revenue + revenue-chart + SLA. Combined backend suite: 41/41 tests green.

integration_issues.issue: Console warning 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' — carryover from iteration_1, caused by React StrictMode double-mount. Chat still functional. Non-blocker.

issues: Recharts prints console warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial mount (h-64 container width is -1 during first paint). Chart still renders correctly after layout settles. Cosmetic only.

metric-revenue currently shows '0 €' because none of the 2 completed (ABGEHOLT) seed orders have cost breakdown (diagnosis_fee/labor_cost/parts_cost = 0). Bar chart bars are therefore empty. Expected behaviour but user may want seeded revenue data for a nicer demo.

verified_features: MITARBEITER order create with diagnosis 50 + labor 120 + parts 80 → live cost-net=250.00€, cost-tax=47.50€, cost-gross=297.50€ (19% MwSt correct)

Order detail: cost-diagnosis-input/cost-labor-input/cost-parts-input editable; save-costs persists; detail-cost-net/tax/gross recompute; cost-status-badge updates via cost-approve (Bestätigt) and cost-reject (Abgelehnt)

add-part with qty=2 creates used-part row, decrements inventory quantity by 2 (verified via /api/inventory before/after), and increases parts_cost by unit_price*2; remove-part restores stock and reduces parts_cost — verified in backend pytest
manual-status-select as MITARBEITER changes status to WARTEN_ERSATZTEIL and FERTIG (200); rejected for ZUGEWIESEN (403)
TECHNIKER accept → start-repair → wait-part (WARTEN_ERSATZTEIL) → resume-repair → mark-ready (FERTIG) full flow works
TECHNIKER cannot see customer_name/phone/email/address (dsgvo_masked=true confirmed both API + Playwright text-scan of body)
TECHNIKER CAN add/remove used parts (part-select visible; API 200)
Abholschein modal opens with print-receipt-button and download-pdf-button; PDF click does not throw JS error
Live camera modal opens on order-open-camera (create) and open-camera (detail) with camera-mode-photo/video/shutter/record/close; graceful close on getUserMedia denial
ADMIN dashboard: metric-revenue rendered, revenue-chart (recharts) renders with 5 branches, SLA metric + list render without errors
Backend compute_costs: 30+100+20 → net=150, tax=28.5, gross=178.5 (19%) — exact
Backend stats.revenue_by_branch returns exactly 5 branch objects with {branch, revenue, orders, completed}
Regression: admin/mitarbeiter/techniker login with Repair2026! still works; /api/auth/register absent
action_items: OPTIONAL (design polish): Seed the 2 ABGEHOLT demo orders with realistic diagnosis_fee/labor_cost so metric-revenue and revenue-chart show non-zero values out of the box.
OPTIONAL (cosmetic): Wrap Recharts <ResponsiveContainer> with a defined min-height/min-width or add aspect prop to silence 'width(-1) height(-1)' console warning on first mount.

OPTIONAL (dev): The '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning originates from a dev-tooling annotator (x-source-* attributes injecting <span style=display:contents> into <option> tags). Not present in production build, but if it comes from the app's build system consider disabling that source-map inspector in dev to reduce noise.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py compute_costs()/serialize_order() correctly computes net/tax/gross and always attaches o['cost']; cost_status default WARTET; validated set COST_STATES={WARTET,BESTAETIGT,ABGELEHNT}.
routes.py add_used_part/remove_used_part correctly $inc quantity on inventory and recomputes parts_cost. Insufficient-stock path returns 400 with German message.
routes.py update_status expanded mitarbeiter allow-list to include WARTEN_ERSATZTEIL/IN_BEARBEITUNG/FERTIG — matches requirement. Techniker restricted to IN_BEARBEITUNG/WARTEN_ERSATZTEIL/FERTIG.
Techniker PII masking still enforced in serialize_order for the added cost/used_parts responses (verified via GET /orders/{id} as chris) — DSGVO intact.

MongoDB _id → id conversion consistent across all serializers; no ObjectId leaks. All routes ≤ ~670 lines in single file (routes.py); acceptable but could be split into orders_routes.py / costs_routes.py / inventory_routes.py if it grows further.
Frontend live totals in OrderCreate use inline useMemo; matches backend rounding (2 decimals * 1.19). Consistent.
seed_data_creation: One test order was created via mitarbeiter UI flow (device: iPhone 14 Pro Test, customer 'Testkunde IT2') and taken through cost update, used part add/remove, manual status changes, and techniker completion (FERTIG). Additional 1 order created via backend fixture in test_iteration2.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite = /app/backend/tests/*.py (pytest -v runs all 41 tests). Iteration 2 features (Kostenaufschlüsselung with 19% MwSt, cost_status WARTET/BESTAETIGT/ABGELEHNT, used_parts with automatic Lagerabzug, mitarbeiter manual status incl WARTEN_ERSATZTEIL, Abholschein modal + jsPDF download, CameraCapture getUserMedia, admin revenue + revenue_by_branch, techniker WARTEN_ERSATZTEIL flow) all validated. Camera flow verified in modal-open/modal-close only (headless has no camera hardware — as expected). No blockers.
